name: HealthQuery
description: Integrated Google Fitbit health data query tool. Supports Steps, Heart Rate, Sleep analysis via Fitbit Web API.
author: VCP Developer

TOKEN_FILE.description: Local OAuth token file name or absolute path.

FITBIT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Fitbit API request timeout in seconds.

DEBUG_MODE.description: Enable local debug logging of health query activity.

invocationCommands.description:
Check if the Fitbit API authorization is valid.
Returns authentication status.

Trigger the Fitbit OAuth2 authorization flow. Opens a browser window for the user to log in.
Use this if 'auth_status' returns false or invalid.

Get daily activity summary (Steps, Calories, Distance, Active Minutes).
Params:
- date (string, optional): 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'today'. Default 'today'.
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」HealthQuery「末」,
command:「始」query_daily_summary「末」,
date:「始」today「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
